response.sql:
WITH g AS (
  SELECT ReportsTo, COUNT(*) AS EmployeeCount
  FROM Employee
  GROUP BY ReportsTo
),
s AS (
  SELECT ReportsTo, EmployeeCount,
         EmployeeCount * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(EmployeeCount) FROM g) AS Share
  FROM g
)
SELECT ReportsTo, EmployeeCount, Share,
       Share - (SELECT AVG(Share) FROM s) AS ShareDiff
FROM s
ORDER BY ShareDiff DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: An empty ReportsTo means NULL, since the column is an integer foreign key with DEFAULT NULL; NULLs form one group, which GROUP BY keeps and which is displayed as a blank/NULL ReportsTo.
The total is the sum of all group counts (every employee), and the average is taken across the groups (AVG over the per-group shares), which is the literal reading of the request.
